name: solar-shop-directus
description: Headless B2B e-commerce store for photovoltaic equipment: Directus + Next.js
author: Jacek Wojarski

scripts.schema:apply: docker compose exec -T directus npx directus schema apply --yes /directus/schema/snapshot.yaml && docker compose restart directus
scripts.schema:snapshot: docker compose exec -T directus npx directus schema snapshot --yes --format=yaml /tmp/snapshot.yaml && docker compose cp directus:/tmp/snapshot.yaml directus/snapshot.yaml
